t: The opposite of the $(l:programming/inventory_import)Inventory Import/$ widget: the $(l:tools/drone)Drone/$ will move to the nearest inventory within the specified $(l:programming/area)area/$ to drop off items from the $(item)Drone's/$ inventory.$(p)$(thing)Right-click/$ the widget for a setup GUI where you can specify the sides of the inventory the Drone should export items to. You can also specify a maximum number of items to export.

与$(l:programming/inventory_import)从容器提取物品/$组件相反：$(l:tools/drone)无人机/$会移动到指定$(l:programming/area)区域/$内最近的容器，将$(item)无人机/$容器中的物品放入其中。$(p)$(thing)右击/$该组件可打开设置 GUI，在其中你可以指定无人机应将物品导出到该容器的哪些面。你还可以指定要导出的最大物品数量。

You can also connect any number (including zero) of $(l:programming/item_filter)Item Filter/$ widgets to limit the items that may be exported. Remember, filters on the $(italic)right/$ acts as a whitelist, and filters on the $(italic)left/$ act as a blacklist.$(p)This widget is done executing when the $(item)Drone's/$ inventory is empty, or when there's no inventory (or inventories) in the area which can accepts the items to be exported.
你还可以连接任意数量（包括零个）的$(l:programming/item_filter)物品过滤器/$组件，以限制可导出的物品。记住，位于$(italic)右侧/$的过滤器充当白名单，而位于$(italic)左侧/$的过滤器充当黑名单。$(p)当$(item)无人机的/$容器为空，或区域内没有能接受待导出物品的容器时，此组件就会执行完毕。
